name: colander-monorepo
description: Private pnpm workspace for the Colander packages.

scripts.check: vp check && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run audit && pnpm --dir examples/react-app run check && pnpm --dir examples/nest-app run check
scripts.check:examples: pnpm --dir examples/react-app run check && pnpm --dir examples/nest-app run check
scripts.fmt:check:examples: pnpm --dir examples/react-app run fmt:check && pnpm --dir examples/nest-app run fmt:check
scripts.fmt:examples: pnpm --dir examples/react-app run fmt && pnpm --dir examples/nest-app run fmt
scripts.lint:examples: pnpm --dir examples/react-app run lint && pnpm --dir examples/nest-app run lint
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present run audit
scripts.release:pack: pnpm --filter @ailura/colander run build:wasm:release && pnpm run pack
